title: The New Covenant
definition: The New Covenant is God's promised covenant fulfilled in Christ, bringing forgiveness, new hearts, and the gift of the Spirit.
summary: The New Covenant is God's promised saving arrangement in Christ, marked by forgiveness, new hearts, and the Spirit's work.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the mediator of the New Covenant, sealed by His blood.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The New Covenant fulfills God's promises to write His law on hearts, forgive sins, and create a people who truly know Him. It is established by the blood of Jesus and applied by the Spirit. This doctrine helps believers see salvation as promised, purchased, and personally applied.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because Christianity is not a disconnected religious system but the fulfillment of God's redemptive promises. The New Covenant gives confidence that God changes hearts, not merely outward behavior. It also gives deep meaning to the Lord's Supper and the Church's worship.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Read Scripture with attention to God's covenant faithfulness. Give thanks for forgiveness and the Spirit's inward work. Let the New Covenant move you from external religion to heart-level obedience.
